name: Conventional Commit Builder
summary: Build Conventional Commits messages — type, scope, breaking change, body, and footers.
description: Compose commits in the Conventional Commits format: feat/fix/docs type, optional scope, description, breaking-change bang, body, BREAKING CHANGE footer, and issue references. Live header preview and length guidance included.

faqs.question: What is Conventional Commits?
faqs.answer: A lightweight convention: type(scope): description, optional body/footer, and BREAKING CHANGE for incompatible API changes.

faqs.question: When do I use the breaking toggle?
faqs.answer: When the commit introduces an incompatible change. The header gets a ! after the type/scope and a BREAKING CHANGE footer is added.

faqs.question: Which types are supported?
faqs.answer: feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, and revert — the common Conventional Commits set.

faqs.question: Is my message uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser.
